subtitle: A Simple Tool for Big Decisions
sentences: Today, I would like to talk about SWOT analysis, one of the first tools you will learn in an MBA program.
SWOT stands for strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats.
Strengths and weaknesses are internal factors that a company can control, such as its brand, talent, or technology.
Opportunities and threats are external factors, like new markets, changing customer needs, or strong competitors.
A good SWOT analysis helps managers build on their strengths and reduce risks before they make a strategic decision.
For example, Netflix used its strength in technology to turn the opportunity of streaming into global growth.
